title: Sorcha Agent Persona v1
description: Declarative non-reactive behaviour for a Sorcha agent. Referenced from an actor config via the 'personaFile' field.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor IntelliSense. Ignored at runtime.

name.description: Human-readable persona label; appears in logs and audit entries.

blueprintId.description: Blueprint whose starting action will be submitted. Supports {{placeholders}} resolved from state.json.

instanceId.description: Pre-created blueprint instance ID. Supports {{placeholders}} resolved from state.json.

actionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the target action in the blueprint.

payloadTemplate.description: JSON template submitted at each fire. String values may contain ${token} substitutions; a string that is exactly '${token}' is replaced by the token's typed result (integer, decimal, or array element) rather than a stringified form.

delaySeconds.description: Optional delay between agent start and the single fire.

everySeconds.description: Interval between fires in seconds. Mutually exclusive with everyMinutes.

everyMinutes.description: Interval between fires in minutes. Mutually exclusive with everySeconds.

startDelaySeconds.description: Optional delay before the first fire.

maxIterations.description: Stop after N successful fires. Optional.

until.description: Stop at this wall-clock timestamp (ISO 8601). Optional.

payloadTemplate.siteAddress: Plot 7-12, Craig na Gower Avenue, Aviemore, PH22 1RW
